text: How does asyncio.Lock decide who gets the lock next when several tasks are waiting? Draw it for me. The source is locks.py.
Vẽ cho tôi xem RotatingFileHandler quyết định khi nào xoay file log, code ở handlers.py. Gửi ảnh nhé.
Make me a picture of the states a TarFile object goes through, from tarfile.py. PNG please.
I just joined this project (the shop folder). Give me a diagram of how the pieces fit together.
Kiến trúc của repo shop trông thế nào? Vẽ ra giúp mình với.
Here's our database schema (schema.sql). Can you visualize the tables and how they relate?
tickets.csv has every status change of our support tickets last month. Show me visually how tickets move between statuses.
Notes from today's planning call are in standup.md. Turn the decisions and who depends on whom into something visual I can paste in Slack.
From kickoff.md, make a timeline image of the milestones we agreed.
team.json lists everyone and their manager. I need an org chart image for the onboarding doc.
Draw the services in docker-compose.yml and what talks to what.
Draw how the OAuth authorization code flow works between the browser, the app and the auth server.
Vẽ quy trình hoàn tiền cho khách: khách gửi yêu cầu, CSKH kiểm tra, nếu quá 30 ngày thì từ chối, không thì kế toán duyệt rồi chuyển tiền.
Sketch a wireframe of a login screen: email, password, a forgot-password link and a Google sign-in button.
Give me a visual of how TCP, IP, HTTP and TLS relate to each other, for a junior developer.
Brainstorm ideas for a team offsite and map them out as a picture.
Can you turn rfc-payments.md into a diagram? I'm presenting it on Monday.
plan.csv has our tasks with owners, start and end dates. Make a Gantt chart picture of it.
Model our hiring process in BPMN: the recruiter screens, the hiring manager interviews, then a panel, an offer and a background check.
Show the sequence of calls when shop/api.py handles a checkout request.
Vẽ các trạng thái của một đơn hàng: mới, đã thanh toán, đang giao, đã giao, đã hủy, đã hoàn tiền.
trace.log is one request traced across our services. Visualize the path the request took.
Draw a C4 context diagram for the shop system in this folder.
legacy.drawio is a mess. Can you clean it up and redraw it so it looks decent?
Use the flow plugin to draw how the shop handles a refund.
I keep forgetting how our deploy works (deploy.sh). Can you make me a cheat-sheet image of it?
What's the class structure in shop/models.py? A picture would help.
Draw an AWS architecture for a web app: CloudFront, an ALB, ECS services and RDS across two availability zones, plus S3 for uploads.
Vẽ cách FeedParser tách một email multipart, code ở feedparser.py. Gửi ảnh để mình xem trên điện thoại.
Explain visually, step by step, how a hash map handles collisions.
Plot monthly revenue from sales.csv as a bar chart.
Explain in words how asyncio.Lock works, from locks.py. No diagram needed.
Fix the bug in shop/cart.py where the coupon is applied twice.
Summarise standup.md as bullet points for an email to the team.
Make a slide deck from kickoff.md.
Convert tickets.csv to JSON, one object per ticket with its list of changes.
Generate a picture of a cat reading a book by a window, watercolour style.
Review docker-compose.yml for security problems.
Draw a histogram of how long tickets took to resolve, from tickets.csv.
Make a line chart of revenue by month from sales.csv, as a PNG.
Build a login page in React with email, password and a Google sign-in button.
Add a Mermaid diagram of the order states to shop/README.md.
In your reply, sketch the TCP three-way handshake as ASCII art. Don't create any files.
Make an illustrated poster announcing our team offsite: mountains, a lake, a campfire.
